name: changes
title: wsync changes
description: Alias for `wsync diff`, intended for reviewing what stayed disk-side after connect.
notes: Lists the pending Studio-first disk review: disk-only entries the connect-time apply left untouched and `differs` entries whose disk original was preserved. Only what the project's tree and scope map is ever compared, so out-of-projection files are ignored, never deleted.
Identical output contract to `wsync diff`; the two names exist so both a review question and a resync question read naturally.
